ducking: Music ducks -8 dB under every line (library default); the tension note sits lower than that (about -20 before ducking) because both uses are 'barely audible'; about -40 under l25 and l27.
Beds duck under every phone-filtered line (l15 to l24, l26) so the narrow band is never competing with full-band room tone; the crossing bed goes right down under l25 and l27 (sfx_notes b10, b11).
b10's 1.5 s before l24: bulb hum, the faint hiss and sparse needles only; crickets pulled to near nothing.
Effects under lines (cuff clink, button, cuff fold, phone into pocket, needles) sit at -18 or lower and between words where the take allows.

filters.phone: Library mix.phone_filters.handset_on_wool: narrow band plus a short hollow tin-shed echo (the godown heard through Pushpa's handset on speaker), wide enough that every consonant survives. lyr_phone_line_hiss under it. The same chain carries the b7 footsteps, the b9 paper slip and the b10 pocket rustle. l24's laugh may distort a little in the chain (light extra saturation on the laugh only); the words of l24 stay clean.
filters.dry_lines: l01 to l14 (the lobby and the crossing) and the stall's own voices l22, l25, l27 are dry. l22 is Nandini's murmur as she writes: dry, close, low. l25 and l27 are fully clear over a ducked bed.
